notes.title: Roots of Insanity Update v0.02 (17th of May 2017)
notes.notes:
Greetings,

It's been a while since you heard from us. We were working about our second huge update for almost a month and we believe we finally managed to finish it. This update, we mainly changed gameplay and more importantly, the combat system.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/9619b29438ddf6ba6324fa86c0c8ad1c96a472bd.png[/img]

[b][u]Update v0.02[/u][/b]

[*] Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese and Russian languages have been fixed and they have been checked by native speakers.

[*] New weapon added (Axe). If you aim a zombie's head with it, you can chop their head off.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/26b0881e99fea29d655da1cc724e61465c0dfce1.jpg[/img] 

[*] Butter knife has been changed to the butcher knife. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/94936236d589c54fe94682ca5d75a8a55ee1748f.jpg[/img]

[*] Weapons' damage have been balanced.

[*] Health and Energy bars, along with some new visual aspects, have been added to the interface

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/47ef392e6e86b17164348dae8aebf2266c14f4e5.jpg[/img]

[*] Environment has been reorganized and new objects have been added.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/64786ea6bc96083a87a2290a683e8d5fd2c3e4d6.jpg[/img]

[*] Added inspection mechanic.

[*] New inspectable objects have been added. You will be able to take some of them. They will provide health, energy, or battery, depending on the item.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/93fa51b24335beef2c2f5d8fa7c0d4c49ddf31b1.jpg[/img]

[*] Added new puzzle to Unknown Forest level

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/d9e1af1304f54112d2cd420451d54f4b0666cbc2.jpg[/img]

[*] Jump mechanic has been added.

[*] Fridges have better loot mechanic now. If you do not find any medicine two times in a row, third fridge will have one for sure.

[*] Subtitles and widgets can be disable now.[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/4ba152d420998b980cba0b6b641f2529ac88587e.jpg[/img]

Roots of Insanity is now more exciting and horrifying than ever. So, what are you waiting for?
ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Roots of Insanity Update V0.01 notes!! (April 10 2017)
notes.notes:
Greetings,

As you know, we recently published Roots of Insanity at your services. After we saw some bugs and problems, we tried to fix them as much as we could. Please do not hesitate to get in touch if you have any more problems or ideas about the game. 
This is our support e-mail: support@craniagames.com
You can reach directly our developers with this e-mail.

[b][u]UPDATE V0.01[/u][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28006067/3e8ca2e8e30c618e536fdd95e898caf9cdb99d41.png[/img]


- Difficulties are rescaled:

          a) Running zombies health has been reduced . 
          b) ''Kick'' and ''Slash'' ranges have been increased.
          c) Damage of Crawler Zombies has been reduced.

- Interactable loots are shinier and easier to reach now. (batteries, medicines, keys and notes.)

- Game has been optimized (Resolution scale has been added.) 

- Zombie bugs such as stuck in cliffs and doors or jumping on the other objects are fixed.

- Zombie path findings has been fixed (We still working on it).

- FPS drops in menu has been fixed.

- 2 new medicines has been added.

- 2 new batteries has been added.


[b]FIXED AREAS[/b]

- Gameplay of the ''Floor 1 - The Patient'' has been fixed.

- Gameplay of the ''Unknown Courtyard'' has been changed.

- Gameplay of the ''Annex - The Forest has'' been  fixed.

- Gameplay of the ''Basement - Generator Room'' has been changed.

[b]Have Fun![/b]
